Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds with exact activity measurements in assay CHEMBL4649952. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno, and join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4649952, standard_relation '=', and standard_value not null. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
